0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, 0-4 at home, on a four-game losing streak) in the Kings' 11th game of the season, with Sacramento 15th in the West and seven games back in the Pacific, while Orlando is 12th in the East and four games back in the Southeast. This is the first meeting between the teams this season, after the Kings lost both games to the Magic in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026. Ruled out for Sacramento are Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision.
